responsibility: Implements the D front end’s type-system behavior and global type singletons. It initializes builtin types and mangling tables, provides type copying/equality/equivalence and interned decoration management, implements parameter traversal and covariance checks, and supplies many operational helpers behind the abstract type hierarchy, making it the main runtime implementation counterpart to the structural declarations in `mtype.h`.
same_name_distinction: This `.c` file is the implementation half of the `mtype` pair; unlike `mtype.h`, which declares the type hierarchy and APIs, it defines the global builtin-type instances, type string-table setup, merging/equality behavior, and operational routines behind type semantics and parameter covariance.
